repos_data.description: Imgcompress is a self-hosted image processing toolbox that handles compression, format conversion, and AI background removal in a single web interface. It supports over 70 input formats (including PSD, HEIC, and RAW) and can output common formats or generate PDFs, all without sending files to external services.
QR Code, DataMatrix, GS1, Code 128 and more. Generates PDF, EPS, SVG, PNG images.
